packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Provider with FTSE 350/250 board composition data, proven methodology for diversity metrics, and an annual refresh cycle aligned to AGM seasons.
packages.inspection_requirements: Verify data refresh date and check classification methodology for ethnicity/race categories against the client's reporting taxonomy.
packages.acceptance_tests: Spot-check data accuracy against five company annual reports; confirm refresh date is current.

packages.package_name: Board evaluation platform or survey tool
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Secure survey/evaluation platform supporting confidential board assessments, anonymity thresholds, and exportable coded results.
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm UK GDPR-aligned data residency, access controls, and that anonymity thresholds prevent re-identification of small boards.
packages.acceptance_tests: Run a pilot questionnaire with the engagement team; verify anonymity aggregation and report export.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Independent evaluator with FTSE 350 experience, no conflicts of interest, and a documented effectiveness methodology; rotation compliant with UK Code Provision 21 (no more than six consecutive engagements).
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm independence declaration, six-year rotation compliance, and that the methodology covers diversity and dynamics.
packages.acceptance_tests: Review references from two comparable FTSE 350 boards; confirm scope and deliverables in the statement of work.

packages.package_name: Board candidate database / executive search firm
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Search firm with demonstrable access to diverse, board-ready candidate networks; transparent sourcing methodology; willing to commit to diverse slates.
packages.inspection_requirements: Verify the firm's track record on diverse appointments and the breadth of its candidate network.
packages.acceptance_tests: Require a diverse slate for a live or test vacancy; assess candidate quality and fit.

packages.package_name: DEI maturity assessment tool or framework
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Provider offering a validated DEI maturity model (Compliance to Belonging) with board-applicable assessment instruments.
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm the model is board-applicable (not workforce-only) and evidence-based.
packages.acceptance_tests: Apply the assessment to the client baseline; confirm stage assignment is defensible and reproducible.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: BI/dashboard platform supporting the engagement KPI set, role-based access, and secure handling of sensitive diversity data.
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm access controls, audit logging, and compatibility with the data collection infrastructure.
packages.acceptance_tests: Load the kpi_definitions.json set; verify each KPI renders against sample data with correct access roles.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Service providing current corporate governance code, listing-rule, and disclosure requirements (UK, EU CSRD/ESRS, SEC) with update alerts.
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm coverage of all applicable regimes and timely update alerts.
packages.acceptance_tests: Validate that recent regulatory changes are reflected and that alerting works.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Survey platform supporting confidential stakeholder feedback (board, leadership, employees) with anonymity controls and analytics.
packages.inspection_requirements: Confirm confidentiality controls adequate for board and senior respondents.
packages.acceptance_tests: Pilot a stakeholder feedback survey; verify anonymity and analytics output.
